text.insert: The dashboard presents the Knowledge System by record family and truth status. It does not label a flat statement list as the whole of what the system knows. The default view answers what the system currently believes about code, how that belief is supported, and where review is needed.

The Knowledge tab opens the read-only V2 Explorer. Routes under /api/knowledge/v2 provide summary, tree, units/:unit/targets, record, entities, search, and drift-warnings. The Explorer shows subject records, evidence, links, and attempt history. Its summary includes warned completed tasks and released pending tasks. Review and write controls below remain proposals.

text.insert: The Explorer reads V2 records and keeps facts distinct from attempt history. Proposed review ordering and mutation controls do not describe current API behavior. Every implemented V2 route is GET-only.

The summary counts every completed task whose stored drift_gate is warned. The drift-warnings endpoint lists recent warned tasks only when their payload resolves to a target or entity; it defaults to 50 rows and caps limit at 100. A unit batch warning may therefore contribute to the summary without appearing in this list. Target totals include moved rows, so they are not a count of active targets.
